name: Haircuts
source:
It starts off at the start of summer vacation, after the protagonist's freshman year. It's a story about a fateful haircut where the protagonist meets his crush, Samantha.

[From[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=9220] Lemma Soft[/url]]
translation:
故事从主人公一年级后的暑假开始时开始。这是一个关于命运的故事，主角遇到了他暗恋的人萨曼莎。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=9220] Lemma Soft[/url]]
